security_class.span: FMO will be merged with and into KYN, with the shares converted into shares of common stock, par value $0.001 per share, of KYN

acquirer.value: Kayne Anderson Energy Infrastructure Fund, Inc.
acquirer.span: relating to the proposed combination of Fiduciary/Claymore Energy Infrastructure Fund (“FMO”) and Kayne Anderson Energy Infrastructure Fund, Inc. (“KYN”), pursuant to which FMO will be merged with and into KYN

targets.span: relating to the proposed combination of Fiduciary/Claymore Energy Infrastructure Fund (“FMO”) and Kayne Anderson Energy Infrastructure Fund, Inc. (“KYN”), pursuant to which FMO will be merged with and into KYN

n_targets.span: Statement of Additional Information regarding the proposed merger of FMO into KYN

exchange_basis.span: The aggregate NAV of KYN common stock (plus the cash distributed in lieu of fractional common shares) received by FMO common shareholders in the Merger will equal the aggregate NAV of FMO shares held on the business day prior to closing of the Merger.

spans: The Merger shall have been approved by “a majority of the outstanding voting securities” as defined in the 1940 Act of the Target Fund

On the Closing Date, no court or governmental agency of competent jurisdiction shall have issued any order that remains in effect and that restrains or enjoins the Target Fund or the Surviving Fund from completing the transactions contemplated by this Agreement.
The Registration Statement shall have become effective under the 1933 Act and no stop orders suspending the effectiveness thereof shall have been issued
Surviving Fund and the Target Fund shall have received the opinion of Paul Hastings LLP, dated as of the Closing Date

The Surviving Fund shall have received from any relevant state securities administrator such order or orders as are reasonably necessary or desirable under the 1933 Act, the 1934 Act, the 1940 Act, and any applicable state securities or blue sky laws
All of the consents of other parties referenced on Schedule 2.2(c) have been obtained

expected_close.span: The Merger is expected to take effect as soon as practicable once the shareholder vote and other customary conditions to closing are satisfied, which is expected to occur during the first quarter of fiscal 2022.

termination_date.span: by either the Surviving Fund or Target Fund if the Effective Time does not occur on or prior to April 13, 2022

record_date.span: The Board has fixed the close of business on October 29, 2021, as the record date for the determination of shareholders entitled to notice of, and to vote at, the Meeting

notes: Initial N-14 8C (filed 2021-10-22) for the merger of FMO (Delaware statutory trust, registered closed-end fund) into KYN (Maryland corporation, registered closed-end fund); only FMO shareholders vote. The special meeting date is left blank in this preliminary filing (', 2022'), so meeting_date is null. The exchange ratio is not fixed: it is set from the relative NAVs per share on the business day before closing; the filing gives an illustrative ratio of approximately 1.32 KYN shares per FMO share using 2021-09-30 NAVs (KYN $9.05, FMO $11.95), so exchange_ratio is null. Cash is paid only in lieu of fractional shares. No collar is mentioned. 'other' condition covers third-party consents (Section 7.3) and officers' certificates / no material merger litigation (Sections 5 and 6) / Section 15(f) compliance. regulatory_approval is read from Section 5.3 (orders from state securities administrators) and Section 7.2(a) (no unfavorable SEC advisory report under 1940 Act Section 25(b)). The 'first quarter of fiscal 2022' timing is as stated (fiscal year not further defined in the Q&A).
